name: Natalie
source: When [url=/c121266]Noel[/url] moves back to Hawthorn, Natalie is the one who takes her in. She, along with her daughter, [url=/c121268]Zoey[/url], enjoy the company, especially in light of the recent death of Natalie's husband. While she maintains a strong front, the grief has affected her more heavily than she lets on, so much so that Zoey has taken notice. Her friendship with [url=/c121267]Elliot[/url] and Noel's presence both help lessen the pain.
